per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in the first paragraph AgentCo’s insertion of “Delaware”
per_rubric.justification: AgentCo's "Dela" and "ware" insertions in the opening paragraph (p-001) remain untouched with no contradicting tracked change.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.3 AgentCo’s deletion of “or settlement agreement”
per_rubric.justification: AgentCo's deletion of "or settlement agreement" in the Applicable Law definition (p-008) remains struck through and is not reversed.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.3 AgentCo’s deletion of “and  all Payment Card Industry (“PCI”) requirements, which shall include, without limitation, PCI Data Security Standards (“PCI DSS”) for the collection, transmission, processing, storage, protection and disclosure of applicable Confidential Information (as defined below); in each case, and all applicable successor provisions and standards.”
per_rubric.justification: AgentCo's deletion of the PCI requirements language in p-008 remains struck through; LargeCo did not reinstate it.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.6 AgentCo’s deletion of ““Deliverables” means all deliverables, observations, summaries, analyses, network maps, results, reports and other work product or information identified, gathered, created, and compiled and/or generated by the Services or Provider as may be further described in an Order Form.”
per_rubric.justification: AgentCo's deletion of the "Deliverables" definition (p-011) remains struck through with no reinsertion.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.18 AgentCo’s insertion of ““Usage Data” means information about access to, interaction with, or use of the Service by LargeCo or on LargeCo’s behalf — including frequency, duration, volume, feature and function usage, visit, session, click-through and click-stream data, together with any statistical or other analyses, information, or derivative works generated from any of the foregoing. Usage Data excludes LargeCo Data including any Personal Data.”
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo's tracked replacement of the Usage Data exclusion sentence in p-024 modifies AgentCo's inserted definition, so it is not left intact.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 3.2 AgentCo’s insertion of “Conditioned on LargeCo’s compliance with the terms of this agreement”
per_rubric.justification: The "Conditioned on LargeCo's compliance" language does not appear in the Access Grant (p-028) and no tracked rejection of it exists.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in 3.3.5 AgentCo’s insertion of “Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, LargeCo acknowledges and agrees that human intervention is needed for the AI Outputs, and AngetCo expressly disclaims all liability for LargeCo’s hiring decisions and unreviewed use of AI Outputs, LargeCo’s job criteria, candidate notices, workflows, or employment decisions.”
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo struck AgentCo's human-intervention and disclaimer insertion in p-034 (rev-533), which contradicts the criterion of accepting it.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 3.3.6 AgentCo’s insertion of “Provider may collect and use Usage Data to  develop, improve, support, and operate the Service. Provider will not share Usage Data containing LargeCo’s Confidential Information with any third party.”
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo struck AgentCo's "develop, improve, support, and operate" Usage Data language in p-035 and substantively rewrote it, so it is not accepted.

per_rubric.criteria: Accept in Section 14.1(i) AgentCo’s deletion of “high-quality” and “the highest”
per_rubric.justification: The deletions of "high-quality" and "the highest" in Section 14.1(i) (p-076) remain struck through; LargeCo's "best" insertion does not reverse them.

per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 16.1  language that excludes Provider's indemnity obligations for a breach of Exhibit C and breach of confidentiality from Provider's limitation of liability cap.
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo's p-085 insertion carves confidentiality, data protection (Exhibit C-type), and indemnification breaches out of the general cap, though it applies a 5X sub-cap.
